name: Flexible Fare Finder
note: One price model drives a 7×7 depart-by-return matrix laid out as row subgrids, whose crosshair is pure :has(), plus a month calendar, the airline “from” prices and a low/typical/high marker that glides on a registered @property — each cell is the minimum of exactly the flights the list shows, and sorts reorder with WAAPI FLIP. Set --apt-fares-h to 100dvh in an app.
html: WayfareFare search

name: Seat Map & Fare Rules
note: The cabin is an ARIA grid of real buttons with roving tabindex, priced from the same table the fare-rules subgrid prints; travellers fly to their seat as WAAPI ghosts, child and exit-row rules are enforced, and a scaled overview’s lens rides a named scroll-timeline shared through timeline-scope (with a JS fallback). Set --apt-seats-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Day Itinerary Planner
note: Pointer-driven drag reorder with live sibling displacement and FLIP on drop feeds one schedule() pass that recomputes every leg’s mode, minutes and fare, waits and opening-hours conflicts; the SVG route redraws with stroke-dash animation, the camera tweens viewBox to fit the day, and Optimise brute-forces every order against the clock. Set --apt-route-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Boarding Pass Wallet
note: A scrubbable airport clock drives one live(t) state machine: the band colour morphs through registered @property hue and chroma, the old gate is struck and the new one springs in, the walk-to-gate path redraws, and the 2D code is drawn on a DPR-aware canvas inside a pass cut by an intersected radial mask, with a pause when off screen or hidden. Set --apt-pass-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Hotel Map Search
note: One k/tx/ty view transform drives a hand-drawn SVG city and HTML price pins that cluster greedily in screen space and split as you zoom (drag to pan, Ctrl-scroll or +/− to zoom, tweened in log scale); the list and price histogram count exactly the stays inside the last searched area, and the detail drawer prices rooms to the cent. Set --apt-stays-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Weather Packing List
note: A small rules engine turns a nine-day forecast, plans, laundry and bag choice into a list where every line says why it is there and rejected items keep their reason; the weight gauge, @property progress ring and grid-auto-flow: dense suitcase are summed from the same lines, and “wear on the plane” moves weight off the bag. name: Trip Expense Splitter
note: Every NOK or EUR expense is converted once to cents and split by largest-remainder allocation, so balances sum to exactly zero; the diverging bars glide in place and “Simplify debts” redraws a pathLength-animated SVG graph from fifteen pairwise IOUs to a greedy plan of at most n−1 payments that “Paid” records as settlements, with undo. Set --apt-split-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Travel Approvals Desk
note: A written travel policy (cabin by flight time, advance purchase, city hotel caps, fare and carrier, budget headroom) is evaluated per request and explained line by line; approving moves its total into the stacked budget bar, team totals and a cumulative chart whose paths morph through the CSS d property, with J/K/A/E/R shortcuts and undo. Set --apt-desk-h to 100dvh in an app.
